description: This file defines an enum class called InterestCalculationPeriodMethod, which models different strategies for calculating interest periods in loan products within the Fineract platform. It includes methods for retrieving enum instances from integers and checking the type of interest calculation period.

classes.name: InterestCalculationPeriodMethod
classes.description: An enum representing different interest calculation period types (daily, same as repayment period, invalid).

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the interest calculation period method.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the interest calculation period method.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static method that maps an integer to the corresponding enum value, defaulting to INVALID.

methods.name: isDaily
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a daily interest period.

methods.name: isSameAsRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents the same as the repayment period.
